hero.hero-sub: Choosing between LangChain and LlamaIndex is an architecture decision that determines orchestration complexity, retrieval latency, and memory overhead—not just a toolkit preference. LangGraph multi-step agent graphs handle stateful LLM agent orchestration that LlamaIndex alone cannot match, while LlamaIndex hierarchical indexes deliver faster retrieval with meaningfully lower memory footprints. I build with both frameworks and design hybrid production architectures for 2026 that deploy each where it objectively wins.
hero.live: A written, benchmark-backed framework recommendation before any build work begins.
